entry.description: Opted to switch to a combinatorics style independent indentically distributed form of simulation instead of monte carlo. Now my program simulates a matchup and all the probabilities of reaching game states in around 4 seconds. Wrote down handwritten notes, and have been able to understand most of the logic. Need to try to understand how outputs are generated from these massive dictionaries.
